---
title: No overlap with lof
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
lof: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    list-of: [tbl]
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'list-of'
        negate: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['typst-extras-list-of\(\(\(kind: "quarto-float-tbl"']
        - ['typst-extras-list-of\(.*"quarto-float-fig"']
---
